christmas-gift-guide.body:
Christmas shopping is easier with a plan. This Christmas gift guide sorts our favourite gifts by who you are buying for and what you want to spend: perfume gift sets for her and for him, discovery sets for the friend whose taste you are not sure of, skincare gift sets, and stocking fillers under £25. Everything is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, and the full edit is in our Christmas gifts collection.

The short answer

If you know their perfume, buy the gift set: you usually get a travel spray or body lotion alongside the full bottle. If you do not, choose a discovery set of miniatures. For skincare lovers, a two-step skincare set feels generous without guesswork. And fill stockings with miniatures and lip care.

Perfume gift sets for her

  • Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£84.99): 100ml eau de parfum, a 10ml travel spray and 100ml body lotion; a white floral of jasmine and tuberose.
  • Hugo Boss Alive Eau de Parfum and Body Lotion Set (£64.99): 80ml eau de parfum with a 75ml matching body lotion for layering.
  • Burberry Women’s Miniature Perfume Set (£45.99): four 5ml minis from the Burberry Her family, including Her London Dream.
  • Calvin Klein Women’s Miniature Fragrance Set (£33.99): four 15ml bottles with Obsession, Eternity and CK One.

Torn between the two Eternity scents? Read Calvin Klein Eternity for women vs for men. See every set in gifts for her and perfume gift sets, or read our perfume gift sets guide. Our Mugler perfume guide compares Alien and Angel.

Perfume gift sets for him

  • Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau de Toilette Intense Gift Set (£68.99): a 100ml bottle and two 10ml travel sprays; bergamot, lavender and a moss liquor accord.
  • Bvlgari Man Rain Essence Gift Set (£54.99): 100ml and 15ml eau de parfum; fresh green tea, white lotus, musk and guaiac wood.
  • Dolce & Gabbana Men’s Miniature Fragrance Set (£34.99): five minis including K, The One and Light Blue Pour Homme.
  • Chopard Oud Malaki (£48.99): for the man who likes warm scents, with tobacco, leather and oud.

More in gifts for him. Buying Dior Sauvage? Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum explains which to choose, and our Tom Ford perfume guide compares Black Orchid, Noir Extreme and more. For 1 Million, Invictus and Phantom, see our Paco Rabanne perfume guide.

Not sure what they wear? Choose a discovery set

Discovery sets are the safest perfume gift: several scents in small sizes, so they can find a favourite. Dior Iconics Mini Perfume Discovery Set (£92.99) has five 5ml Dior fragrances for women and men. Hermès Miniature Gift Set (£64.99) holds four 7.5ml scents from the Jardins collection. Acqua di Parma Holiday Discovery Set (£54.99) brings Osmanthus, Yuzu and Lily of the Valley in 12ml sprays. On a smaller budget, Korloff Paris Discovery Set (£19.99) has three 10ml sprays, and Signature Discovery Set (£75.99) has ten. For what is inside each miniature set, see our mini perfume sets guide. Wondering what the labels mean? Read extrait vs eau de parfum.

Skincare gift sets

  • Highborn London Ultimate Day & Night Moisture Set (£95): Imperial Moisturiser and Night Elixir, both in 50ml jars.
  • Highborn London Revive and Defy Starter Set (£78): 30ml Pre-Eminent Beauty Serum and 15ml Imperial Eye Gel.
  • Vilvah Milk Face Kit (£45.99): Milk Mud Mask and Milk Drops serum, from one of our official partner brands.
  • anatomē The Little Gift of Good Sleep (£35): a 10ml Somali frankincense sleep oil roller ball and a 10ml pillow spray for a calm bedtime ritual.

More boxed sets are in gift sets. Our skincare gift sets guide lists what is in every Vilvah and Deyga kit.

More small gifts in our stocking fillers for her guide.

Delivery and returns

UK delivery is free on orders over £40, and orders over £70 get £5 off with code SAVE5 at checkout, so a couple of gifts in one order often covers both. Everything is dispatched from the UK; order early in December so gifts arrive in time, and see our shipping policy for delivery options. Unopened items can be returned within 14 days of delivery, so leave the cellophane on until the big day (see our refund policy).

Lip balms and lip scrubs

From Deyga, the Shea Saffron Bath Bar and Rose Pink Clay Bath Bar are made with raw shea butter and coconut and olive oils.

mini-perfume-sets-guide.body:
A mini perfume set is a box of small bottles, usually 4ml to 15ml each, from one perfume house. It lets someone try several scents before buying a full bottle, keep a favourite in their bag, or simply enjoy a little collection. Here is what is inside the miniature sets we stock, starting with Jimmy Choo and Dior.

Why choose a mini perfume set?

  • To try before buying: wear each scent for a day or two and see which one you reach for.
  • For travel and handbags: small bottles take up little room.
  • As a gift when you are not sure of their taste: several scents from a house they like is a safer bet than one full bottle.

Sizes vary from set to set, so check the millilitres as well as the number of bottles.

Jimmy Choo mini perfume set

The Jimmy Choo Women’s Miniature Fragrance Gift Set holds five 4.5ml eau de parfums, 22.5ml in all:

  • I Want Choo: peach and mandarin, red spider lily and jasmine, vanilla.
  • Jimmy Choo Eau de Parfum: pear, mandarin and green notes, orchid, toffee and patchouli.
  • I Want Choo Forever: rose and bitter almond, cherry, jasmine and vetiver, vanilla, tonka bean, oakmoss and amber.
  • Rose Passion: frangipani and jasmine, coconut milk and orchid, vanilla and sandalwood.
  • I Want Choo Le Parfum: blackberry, pear and gardenia, jasmine, patchouli and ambrette, praline, sandalwood and moss.

If you already know you love I Want Choo Forever, it also comes as a single 4.5ml miniature. See every Jimmy Choo fragrance.

Dior mini perfume set

The Dior Iconics Mini Perfume Discovery Set has five 5ml minis for women and men: J’adore Eau de Parfum, Miss Dior Eau de Parfum, Miss Dior Eau de Toilette, Hypnotic Poison Eau de Toilette and Sauvage Eau de Toilette. It is the set to choose for someone who loves Dior but whose favourite you do not know. Not sure which Sauvage they wear? Read Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum. More from Dior.

best-perfume-gift-sets-uk-2026.body:
A perfume gift set is the easiest way to give someone a scent they already love, with something extra in the box: a travel spray, a matching body lotion or a few miniatures. This guide is our pick of the perfume gift sets in stock for Christmas 2026, sorted by who you are buying for and what you want to spend. Every set is 100% authentic and shipped from the UK.

How to choose a perfume gift set

  • You know their perfume: buy the set of that scent. A full bottle with a travel spray or lotion costs little more than the bottle alone.
  • You know the brand, not the scent: a miniature set lets them try several perfumes from the same house.
  • You know neither: choose a discovery set, then they can buy the full bottle of the one they like.

Perfume gift sets for her

lattafa-khamrah-qahwa-arabian-perfume.body:
Few perfumes have travelled by word of mouth like Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa. It belongs to a wave of Arabian perfume houses, from Lattafa and Afnan to Al Haramain, Arabiyat Prestige and Maison Alhambra, whose rich, warm scents have found a big following in the UK. Here is what is in Khamrah Qahwa, what makes a perfume "Arabian", and how to choose one.

What does Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa smell like?

"Qahwa" is the Arabic word for coffee, and that is the idea at the heart of Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa Eau de Parfum (£26.99, 100ml). Its notes, from top to base:

  • Top: cinnamon, cardamom and ginger, the spices of Arabic coffee.
  • Heart: praline, candied fruits and white flowers.
  • Base: coffee, vanilla, tonka bean, benzoin and musk.

So it opens spicy, turns sweet and nutty, and settles into coffee and vanilla. It is an amber-woody, gourmand scent made for men and women, and it suits cooler months and evenings best.

More from Lattafa

Lattafa perfume is known for warm, generous scents at friendly prices. Alongside Khamrah Qahwa, we list:

  • Lattafa Teriaq (£29.99): caramel, bitter almond, pink pepper and apricot, then honey, rhubarb and rose over leather, vanilla and musk. Unisex.
  • Lattafa Maahir Black Edition (£25.99): black and pink pepper with saffron, then labdanum and cade oil over leather, cedarwood, guaiac wood and patchouli. A darker, smoky choice.
  • Lattafa Yara Candy (£26.99): green mandarin and blackcurrant, a strawberry-candy and gardenia heart, and vanilla, musk and sandalwood. Made for women.

See every Lattafa scent on the Lattafa page.

Afnan, Arabiyat Prestige and Maison Alhambra

Afnan 9am Dive (£26.99) is the fresh one: lemon, mint, pink pepper and blackcurrant, then apple, incense and cedarwood. Afnan Supremacy Gold (£27.99) is warmer, with nutmeg, violet and peach blossom over amber, vanilla, oud and benzoin. More on the Afnan page.

Arabiyat Prestige Nyla (£25.99, 80ml) is a bright floral-fruity scent for women: coconut, peach and mandarin, then tiare, jasmine and rose over white musk. See Arabiyat Prestige. Maison Alhambra adds a wide range of floral, fruity and woody eau de parfums at friendly prices.

What makes a perfume "Arabian"?

There is no strict rule, but Arabian perfume usually leans on a few ingredients:

  • Oud (agarwood): a deep, woody, slightly smoky note.
  • Amber and resins such as benzoin and labdanum: warm and sweet.
  • Saffron, cardamom and cinnamon: spice.
  • Rose and musk: soft and rounded.

Most of the scents above are eau de parfum, which typically holds around 15–20% perfume oil. Read extrait vs eau de parfum for what each label means.

Arabian perfume in stock now

Warm and spicy

Al Haramain Amber Oud Tobacco Edition (£32.99, 60ml) shares Khamrah Qahwa's love of spice: tobacco leaf, cinnamon, black pepper and ginger, then vanilla, clove, star anise, cacao and tonka bean. Al Haramain Amber Oud Black Edition (£39.99) pairs cardamom and lavender with leather, amber and benzoin.

Sweet and fruity

Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition (from £32.99) is bergamot, melon and pineapple over vanilla and musk, a popular first Arabian perfume. Al Haramain Amber Oud Ruby Edition (from £41.99) mixes saffron and bitter almond with jasmine and ambergris. Al Haramain Amber Musk (£39.99) is softer: amber, musk, vanilla and resins.

Oud and saffron

Fumeri Oud Saffron (£29.99) and SAP Saffron Oud Extrait de Parfum (£43.99) both open on saffron and spice before oud, cedarwood and smoky woods, with amber, leather and musk. Montale Aoud Safran (£62.99) builds on saffron and oud with rose and amber.

Every Al Haramain Amber Oud edition is compared in our Amber Oud guide, and Armaf Club de Nuit in our Armaf Club de Nuit guide. Browse all Arabian perfume and oud perfume. For designer ouds such as Tom Ford Oud Wood and Gucci Intense Oud, read our oud perfume guide.

How to wear a rich, warm perfume

  • Start small: one or two sprays on the neck or wrists. You can add more; you cannot take it away.
  • Spray on moisturised skin, so the scent has something to sit on. We explain how in how to layer oud with body butter.
  • Try it on skin before you decide. Warm notes change over the first hour, so judge the base, not just the first spray.
  • Patch test if your skin is sensitive to fragrance.

Arabian perfume also makes a generous gift: see our Christmas gift guide.

oud-perfume-guide.body:
Oud is one of the most talked-about notes in perfume: deep, woody and a little smoky. Designer houses such as Tom Ford, Gucci, Guerlain and Chopard each have their own take on it. Here is what oud is, how the best-known oud perfumes differ, and how to choose and wear one.

What is oud?

Oud, also called agarwood or aoud, is a dark, fragrant resin that forms in the wood of agar (Aquilaria) trees. It has been treasured in the Middle East and South Asia for centuries, burned as incense and worn as an oil. Natural oud is rare, so many modern perfumes use an oud accord: a blend of woods, resins and leathery notes built to give the same rich effect. Gucci, for example, lists an oud accord in its base notes.

Tom Ford Oud Wood

Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau de Parfum (30ml or 50ml) is the gentlest way into oud. Its key notes are oud wood, rosewood and cardamom over sandalwood, vetiver, tonka bean and amber, so the oud reads smooth and warm rather than smoky. It is unisex and easy to wear in the office or in the evening. See every Tom Ford fragrance, or read our Tom Ford perfume guide for Black Orchid, Noir Extreme and Neroli Portofino.

Gucci Intense Oud

Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum (90ml) is darker. Black pepper and olibanum (frankincense) open it; amber woods, sandalwood and cedarwood sit at the heart; leather, patchouli, gurjun balsam and the oud accord form the base. Expect incense and leather more than sweetness. Shop all Gucci, or compare it with Bloom, Flora Gorgeous and Guilty in our Gucci perfume guide.

Tom Ford Oud Wood or Gucci Intense Oud?

  • Choose Oud Wood if you want a soft, creamy wood with a touch of spice that suits everyday wear.
  • Choose Intense Oud if you like incense, leather and a bolder, smokier trail for evenings and colder months.

Three more oud perfumes

  • Guerlain Oud Essentiel (125ml): saffron and pelargonium, then rose, oud and cedarwood over leather, frankincense and guaiac wood. A rose-and-leather oud, made unisex.
  • Chopard Oud Malaki (80ml): grapefruit, lavender and artemisia, then tobacco, spices and leather over oud, ambergris and dark woods. Made for men, and the most affordable oud in this guide.
  • Montale Aoud Damascus (100ml): damask rose, aoud and saffron with amber, woods and musk. Montale is known for rose and oud, and this one is made for women.

The Al Haramain Amber Oud editions

Al Haramain's Amber Oud range is a popular Arabian line, but read the notes: not every edition is built around oud. Our Amber Oud editions guide compares them all. Amber Oud White Edition is bergamot and orange, then jasmine, rose and freesia over musk, vanilla and patchouli, and is listed for women. Amber Oud Carbon Edition is a fresh, aromatic men's scent of lavender, rosemary, bergamot, sage and vetiver. Amber Oud Bleu Edition is citrus and mint over incense, vetiver and sandalwood. For the Gold, Ruby, Tobacco and Black editions, and for Lattafa, read our guide to Arabian perfume and Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa.

Which oud perfume suits you?

  • New to oud: Tom Ford Oud Wood, or a fresher Amber Oud edition.
  • You love incense and leather: Gucci Intense Oud or Guerlain Oud Essentiel.
  • You love rose: Montale Aoud Damascus or Guerlain Oud Essentiel.
  • Warm and spicy: Chopard Oud Malaki.

Oud is traditionally unisex, so "for men" or "for women" on the label is only a starting point. Browse unisex perfume, perfume for men and perfume for women.

How to wear oud

  1. Start small: one or two sprays. Oud notes are rich, and a little goes a long way.
  2. Apply to moisturised skin on the wrists, neck or chest. Our guide to layering oud with body butter explains why.
  3. Let it settle: do not rub your wrists together. Oud perfumes often change a lot after the first half hour, so judge them later in the day.
  4. Test before you buy a full bottle if you can, or start with a smaller size.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum is the most common strength for oud perfumes; read extrait vs eau de parfum for what the label means.
  • Patch test on your inner arm if you have sensitive skin, and keep perfume away from your eyes.
  • Store bottles away from heat and sunlight, with the cap on.
